statement: Let n = len(nums). For 0 <= a < b <= n, write nums[a..b) for the sequence (nums[a], nums[a+1], ..., nums[b-1]), and let div(a,b) be the number of indices i with a <= i < b such that p divides nums[i]. Let D = { s | there exist integers a,b with 0 <= a < b <= n, s = nums[a..b), and div(a,b) <= k }. Whenever count_distinct(nums,k,p) returns a result r, r is the cardinality of D.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 200; 1 <= k <= len(nums); 1 <= p <= 200; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 200.

statement: For every input satisfying the preconditions, count_distinct(nums,k,p) returns a result r; it does not fail, panic, overflow, or get stuck.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 200; 1 <= k <= len(nums); 1 <= p <= 200; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 200.

statement: Let n = len(nums). Whenever count_distinct(nums,k,p) returns a result r, r <= n*(n+1)/2.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 200; 1 <= k <= len(nums); 1 <= p <= 200; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 200.

statement: Let m = |{ nums[i] | 0 <= i < len(nums) }| be the number of distinct values appearing in nums. Whenever count_distinct(nums,k,p) returns a result r, r >= m.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 200; 1 <= k <= len(nums); 1 <= p <= 200; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 200.

statement: Let n = len(nums). Let div(a,b) be the number of i with a <= i < b such that p divides nums[i]. Let A be the number of pairs (a,b) with 0 <= a < b <= n and div(a,b) <= k. Whenever count_distinct(nums,k,p) returns a result r, r <= A.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 200; 1 <= k <= len(nums); 1 <= p <= 200; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 200.

statement: Whenever count_distinct(nums,k,p) returns a result r, r = 1.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 200; 1 <= k <= len(nums); 1 <= p <= 200; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 200; len(nums) = 1.

statement: Let E be the set of sequences s for which there exist integers a,b with 0 <= a < b <= len(nums), b-a <= k, and s = (nums[a], ..., nums[b-1]). Whenever count_distinct(nums,k,p) returns a result r, r is the cardinality of E.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 200; 1 <= k <= len(nums); 1 <= p <= 200; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 200; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), p divides nums[i].

statement: Let T be the set of sequences s for which there exist integers a,b with 0 <= a < b <= len(nums) and s = (nums[a], ..., nums[b-1]). Whenever count_distinct(nums,k,p) returns a result r, r is the cardinality of T.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 200; 1 <= k <= len(nums); 1 <= p <= 200; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 200; the number of indices i with 0 <= i < len(nums) for which p divides nums[i] is at most k.

statement: Whenever count_distinct(nums,k1,p) returns a result r1 and count_distinct(nums,k2,p) returns a result r2, r1 <= r2.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 200; 1 <= p <= 200; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 200; 1 <= k1 <= k2 <= len(nums).

statement: Whenever count_distinct(nums,k,p1) returns a result r1 and count_distinct(nums,k,p2) returns a result r2, r1 <= r2.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 200; 1 <= k <= len(nums); 1 <= p1 <= 200; 1 <= p2 <= 200; p1 divides p2; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 200.

statement: Let rev(nums) be the sequence (nums[len(nums)-1], nums[len(nums)-2], ..., nums[0]). Whenever count_distinct(nums,k,p) returns a result r and count_distinct(rev(nums),k,p) returns a result r', r = r'.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 200; 1 <= k <= len(nums); 1 <= p <= 200; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 200.

statement: Whenever count_distinct(nums,k,p) returns a result r and count_distinct(nums,k,q) returns a result r', r = r'.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 200; 1 <= k <= len(nums); 1 <= p <= 200; 1 <= q <= 200; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 200; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), p divides nums[i] iff q divides nums[i].

statement: Whenever count_distinct(nums,k,p) returns a result r and count_distinct(nums',k,p) returns a result r', r = r'.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 200; 1 <= k <= len(nums); 1 <= p <= 200; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 200; nums' is an array with len(nums') = len(nums) and 1 <= nums'[i] <= 200 for every i; for all i,j with 0 <= i,j < len(nums), nums[i] = nums[j] iff nums'[i] = nums'[j]; for all i with 0 <= i < len(nums), p divides nums[i] iff p divides nums'[i].

statement: Let U be the set of all sequences s for which there exist integers a,b with 0 <= a < b <= len(nums) and s = (nums[a], ..., nums[b-1]). Whenever count_distinct(nums,k,p) returns a result r, r <= |U|.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 200; 1 <= k <= len(nums); 1 <= p <= 200; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 200.

statement: Let n = len(nums). For 0 <= a < b <= n, let div(a,b) be the number of indices i with a <= i < b such that p divides nums[i]. Let A be the number of pairs (a,b) with 0 <= a < b <= n and div(a,b) <= k. Whenever count_distinct(nums,k,p) returns a result r, r = A.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 200; 1 <= k <= len(nums); 1 <= p <= 200; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 200; for all i,j with 0 <= i < j < len(nums), nums[i] != nums[j].
